extDescription.message: Block the far right: hides the posts of listed far-right accounts and tells X you are not interested, from your feed, at a human pace.

intro.message: Everything on this page stays in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere, except downloading the lists you add. What the extension sends to X goes through your X session, like a click of your own.

stateLine.message: Posts from listed accounts are collapsed on x.com as they render. When a collapsed post is on screen, the extension picks the chosen item in X's own post menu, as if you had done it by hand.

subscribeHttps.message: The address must start with https://

subscribePermission.message: Permission to read that address was refused

ownHelp.message: Accounts you add yourself: here, or with the ⛔ button on posts. One account per line: handle, @handle or profile link.

allowHelp.message: Accounts you want to keep, even if a list contains them. One account per line.

allHelp.message: Subscribed lists and my list, minus the exceptions. "Keep" adds the account to the exceptions: it is no longer hidden.

searchPlaceholder.message: Search a handle or a name…

actionTitle.message: What to do with listed accounts

actionPace.message: Pace: at most $HOUR$ actions per hour and $DAY$ per day, with a pause of $MIN$ to $MAX$ seconds between two. One at a time, only on posts on screen.

actionRisk.message: X forbids bulk automated actions. This pace mimics a person acting while reading their feed, but it is your account that acts: the choice is yours.

whatsNew.message: New in version 0.5: the extension acts from your feed through X's own menu. By default it marks each post "Not interested"; you can choose to mute the accounts instead. The explanation is below.

strip_waiting.message: hidden · will act when the pace allows

actionIntro.message: X's ranking only learns from what you do on posts it has served you, in your feed. Both options act from the post, through X's own menu, with your session.

actionNotInterestedHelp.message: The post is collapsed, then marked "Not interested in this post". Nothing is blocked or muted, so X keeps serving you the account and each new post sends a new negative signal. In X's published ranking code this signal weighs almost twice a block. X offers an Undo on the post.

actionMuteHelp.message: The post is collapsed, then the account is muted from the post menu. The strongest single signal short of a report, but only one per account: X then stops showing you the account, so nothing more is sent. The account is not told. Undo in X's settings ("Muted accounts").

actionProfileNote.message: A block or a mute made on a profile page teaches X's ranking nothing. The extension never acts from a profile page or in the background.

actedTitle.message: What the extension did on X

actedHelp.message: From posts on screen, with your session. Newest first.

logNotInterested.message: @$HANDLE$: "not interested" sent from a post on screen

logMuted.message: @$HANDLE$ muted from a post on screen
